spec.name: Reversal v5
spec.notes: Short-horizon reversal: buy yesterday's losers, sell the winners.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 3.1, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 3%.

exhibits.summary: On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is 3.05 against 3.09 in research, a gap of +0.04.

Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 3.09 to -6.99 (change -10.09). The strategy already trades a bar after its signal, so this measures how fast the signal fades, not look-ahead.
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 3.09 against 3.09 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
At 10 bps the Sharpe ratio is 3.09 (as submitted, 10 bps: 3.09); it breaks even at 15.0 bps with daily turnover 0.71.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 9.24 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean 0.04, 95th percentile 0.55).

verdict.opinion: The strategy's performance metrics are supported by the exhibits, which show consistency between research and sealed periods, no survivorship bias, and robustness to cost changes. The placebo test confirms the signal's significance. No charges were filed, and no damaging evidence was found.
